create_mesh_collision_shape: create a convex mesh collision shape from vertices and face indices using pybullet GEOM_MESH
create_multibody_with_collision: create a multi-body object with a collision shape at a specified position in the simulation
convert_euler_to_quaternion: convert Euler angles to a quaternion orientation for positioning bodies in the simulation
change_body_dynamics: change dynamics properties like spinning friction, rolling friction, and linear damping on a body
control_joint_motor_velocity: set joint motor control with velocity control mode and target velocity on a multi-body
